description: The Kerala High Court is making use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to translate and publish reportable judgements of the Kerala High Court and district courts from English into Malayalam
body_lead: The Kerala High Court is making use of artificial intelligence (AI) to translate and publish reportable judgments of the Kerala High Court and district courts from English into Malayalam. As many as 317 judgments of the Kerala High Court have thus been translated into Malayalam. The translated judgments have been made available on the website of the High Court. In case of district judiciary, 5,186 judgments have been translated and the Malayalam version has been made available on the official websites of the district courts.
